## make a simple regression model

```{r}
bears <- read.csv(file="BEARS.csv",header = TRUE)
#adjust factors to be factors
bears$SEX<- as.factor(bears$SEX)
bears$MONTH<- as.factor(bears$MONTH)
```

## Model LENGTH ~ NECK  this is an example 
```{r}
plot(LENGTH~NECK,data=bears,pch=19)
```

This plot shows as neck circumference increase,length increases as well.The plot is primarily linear.   


```{r}
model.1 <- lm(LENGTH~NECK,data=bears)
summary.lm(model.1)
```

The adjusted R-Squared is 0.7476.

Compare all models that predict LENGTH other than NECK.  
Then order them from worst to best by its value of Adjusted-Rsquared (bigger is better), or by RSE (residual standard error) where smaller is better. 

## Model LENGTH ~ HEADLEN


```{r}
plot(LENGTH~HEADLEN,data=bears,pch=19)
```

  As head length increases so does the length. This boxplot is linear. 
```{r}
model.2 <- lm(LENGTH~HEADLEN,data=bears)
summary.lm(model.2)
```
The adjusted R-squared is 0.8434, bigger than the previous model's. 
  

## Model LENGTH ~ HeadWTH

```{r}
plot(LENGTH~HEADWTH,data=bears,pch=19)
```
This boxplot shows as head width increases, length kind of increases as well. There is some deviation from the previous linear plot.

```{r}
model.3 <- lm(LENGTH~HEADWTH,data=bears)
summary.lm(model.3)
```

   The adjusted R-squared is 0.5321, which is lower than the previous two.

## Model LENGTH ~ CHEST
```{r}
plot(LENGTH~CHEST,data=bears,pch=19)
```
As the chest size increases so does the length, although there is some deviation this plot is pretty linear.
```{r}
model.4 <- lm(LENGTH~CHEST,data=bears)
summary.lm(model.4)
```

   The adjusted R-squared is 0.7869

## Model LENGTH ~ WEIGHT
```{r}
plot(LENGTH~WEIGHT,data=bears,pch=19)
```
  This plot shows as the weight increases, length does as well.

```{r}
model.5 <- lm(LENGTH~WEIGHT,data=bears)
summary.lm(model.5)
```

   The adjusted R-squared is 0.7423,
   
## Final Ranking

  LENGTH~HEADLEN - 0.8434. 
  
  LENGTH~CHEST - 0.7869. 
  
  LENGTH~NECK - 0.7476. 
  
  LENGTH~WEIGHT - 0.7423. 
  
  LENGTH~HEADWTH - 0.5321.
